dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>We'd like to invite you to attend this music festival.</color>

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: Hmm? How did you know I liked music? ... Well, to be truthful, that's where I get most of my creative ideas!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, then you must have music you really enjoy, right? We could play it for you!

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: Oh, that's a long list you'd be looking at... If I had to pick one, it might be this traditional piece from Konda Village.

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: That's where I started my culinary journey, in fact.

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: Could you play the piece if I were to hum the tune for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure, I'll give it a go.
